pr_title: Studio components refactoring and cleanup (Area Chart)
pr_body: ## What kind of change does this PR introduce? Feature: These changes move the Area Chart to its own component, adds stories and ensures that it has proper types. ## What is the current behavior? Partially fixes #6249 [issue link](https://github.com/GitStartHQ/client-supabase/issues/47) Currently we've got the Area Chart in the `components/to-be-cleaned/Charts/ChartRenderer` file, without proper types and stories. ## What is the new behavior? The Area Chart has been moved to `components/ui/charts/LineChart`, with proper types added and stories showing its use with varying props. ## Additional context There isn't a component called LineChart in the ChartRenderer. I'm assuming that the component that needs to be refactored is the AreaChart, since its the only other component alongside the the BarChart in the ChartRenderer.

issue_context.title: Studio components refactoring and cleanup
issue_context.body:
This issue tracks the component library cleanup. Goal is to eliminate the `components/to-be-cleaned` folder, cleanup `packages/ui`.


Each component needs:
- prop typings (no any)
- storybook 

`packages/ui`, cleanup based on [this PR](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/pull/12427/files):
- [ ] Accordion
- [ ] Alert
- [ ] Badge
- [ ] remove Breadcrumb
- [ ] Button
- [ ] Card
- [ ] Checkbox
- [ ] Collapsible
- [ ] Context Menu
- [ ] Divider
- [ ] Dropdown
- [ ] Form
- [ ] GlassPanel
- [ ] Image
- [ ] Icon
- [ ] IconPanel
- [ ] Input
- [ ] InputNumber
- [ ] remove InputOld
- [ ] remove Introduction and related assets
- [ ] Listbox
- [ ] Loading
- [ ] Menu
- [ ] Popover
- [ ] Radio
- [ ] remove RadioOld
- [ ] Select
- [ ] SidePanel
- [ ] remove Space
- [ ] Tabs
- [ ] Textarea
- [ ] ThemeProvider
- [ ] Toast
- [ ] Toggle
- [ ] Typography
- [ ] remove Spinner
- [ ] remove lib/utilities
- [ ] cleanup lib/theme


Requires in-depth studio code refactoring:
- [ ] ChartsRenderer to split into BarChart and AreaChart under `ui/Charts`
  - [x] AreaChart
  - [ ] BarChart 
    - [x] New component + storybook
    - [ ] Removal of deprecated component
- [ ] TooltipListener hook into `<Tooltip>` component


I will add to the list as we go along.
comments: @Isaiah-Hamilton I'll like to start working on this.

@nnaemekaibe feel free to work on. 

This is actually part of quite a large refactor project since we have a lot of components in the `components/to-be-cleaned` so we might close this issue in favour of concentrating efforts on more surface level improvements.

I can keep this issue open if you do intend to do the 'to do' items above ?
Sounds like it's getting storybook examples set up for charts and improving prop typings
@MildTomato Please keep it open so i can handle the todo items.

Hello @MildTomato the PR's for these components are ready, before pushing i need to clarify something. I noticed that i'm supposed to work on the LineChart in ChartsRenderer, but there's no LineChart component in there, what i've got is the BarChart and AreaChart. Is it okay to assume that it's the AreaChart @Ziinc mean't and not LineChart.

review_comments: does not accept props that bar chart accepts (custom no data title/message)

there are certain props that are present in BarChart but missing here (like chart size etc). we should actually add these into the area chart as well.

Should have a common `TimeseriesChart` type that is then used and extended by the AreaChart and BarChart, so that we can keep them in sync.
we should not be accepting this data format anymore. This is the legacy format for chart render. should accept a compatible data format that rechart can receive directly.

please see LineChart PR review for stories changes
- move default args to template
- data generation together with mock props
- story args should not need to spread defaultArgs
as mentioned, the header should not contain this logic.

since area chart and line chart share this logic, could we perhaps abstract this to a hook. 

Also, should not use `any`
